properties.summary: Incident Type: MOBILE - NRC Report ID: 998207 - Medium Affected: WATER - Suspected Responsible Party: HST CARRIER
properties.content:
Report Details
NRC Report ID: 998207
Incident Time: 2011-12-06 13:00:00
Nearest City: Marion, NC
Location: SOIL MEDIAN & STORM DRAIN I-40 E, MM 85-86
Incident Type: MOBILE
Material: OIL: DIESEL
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: HST CARRIER
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 35.685618, -82.003135 (Approximated from CITY_STATE)
Reported Spill Volume: 100 gallons
Report Description
A TRACTOR TRAILER STRUCK A MEDIAN GUARD RAIL, WHICH PUNCTURED BOTH SADDLE TANKS AND RELEASE APPROXIMATELY 100 GALLONS OF DIESEL FUEL ONTO THE SOIL MEDIAN AND ALSO IMPACTED A NEARBY STORM DRAIN THAT LEAD TO A CULVERT UNDERNEATH THE HIGHWAY. THE LOCAL FIRE DEPARTMENT AND MCDOWELL COUNTY EM INITIALLY CONTAINED THE RELEASE WITH ABSORBENTS. HST CONTACTED ERTS ON DECEMBER 14, 2011 AT APPROXIMATELY 1845 EST TO MANAGE THE RELEASE. ERTS DISPATCHED AN ENVIRONMENTAL CONTRACTOR TO THE SITE ON DECEMBER 15, 2011 TO PERFORM CLEANUP OPERATIONS. THE ENVIRONMENTAL CONTRACTOR APPLIED GRANULAR ABSORBENTS TO THE IMPACTED CULVERT TO COLLECT THE CONTAMINATED WATERS. THE ABSORBENTS WILL BE LEFT OVER NIGHT TO COLLECT ANY POTENTIAL RESIDUAL. THE IMPACTED SOIL WILL BE EXCAVATED AND ALL WASTE WILL BE CONTAINERIZED FOR DISPOSAL.

properties.summary: Incident Type: PIPELINE - NRC Report ID: 1190605 - Medium Affected: AIR - Suspected Responsible Party: WILLIAMS
properties.content:
Report Details
NRC Report ID: 1190605
Incident Time: 2017-09-17 12:30:00
Nearest City: Grover, NC
Location: PIPELINE FACILITY
Incident Type: PIPELINE
Material: SMOKE
Medium Affected: AIR
Suspected Responsible Party: WILLIAMS
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 35.170278, -81.410556 (Explicit)
Report Description
*****NRC REPORT # 1190605 IS AN UPDATE TO NRC REPORT # 1190605. THE UPDATE CLARIFIES THAT THERE WAS A RELEASE OF SMOKE CONFIRMED. THE INJURIES WERE INCURRED DURING MUSTER, NOT BECAUSE OF A RELEASE.***** INITIAL: AN ACCIDENTAL IGNITION OCCURRED AS CONTRACTOR WELDERS WERE INSTALLING A NEW SIDE GATE VALVE AT STATION 145. UPON COMPLETING THE REPAIR, THE WELDING PROCESS CONTINUED. UPON STRIKING THE FIRST ARC TO COMPLETE THE WELD, THE IGNITION OCCURRED. THERE WAS A LARGE PRESSURE RELEASE FROM AN 8" PORT AT THE LOCATION OF ONE OF THE INFLATABLE AIR BLADDERS AND THERE WAS NO FLASH FIRE ONSITE, RATHER THE FIRE APPEARS TO HAVE BEEN CONTAINED WITHIN THE PIPING AND EXTINGUISHED WITH THE PRESSURE RELEASE. ALL ONSITE PERSONNEL IMMEDIATELY MUSTERED APPROPRIATELY AND DURING THE MUSTERING, THREE CONTRACTOR INJURIES OCCURRED. TWO RECEIVED MINOR PUMPS AND BRUISE WHEREAS A THIRD FELL AND SUSTAINED A SHOULDER INJURY. POSSIBLE DISLOCATED SHOULDER, CONFIRMATION PENDING. ALL INVOLVED WITH THE WORK WERE SENT HOME. NO NATURAL GAS WAS RELEASED. AN UNKNOWN SMOKE WAS RELEASED FROM THE FIRE. ORIGINAL: THE CALLER IS REPORTING THAT CONTRACTORS WERE WELDING A NEW TIE IN ON A 36 IN HEADER ON A NATURAL GAS LINE TO INSTALL A NEW VALVE, WHEN THEY STUCK A SPARK DURING THE LAST FOOT OF WELDING WHICH CAUSED A 20 FOOT HIGH FLASH FIRE. THE CALLER STATES THAT 3 CONTRACTORS WERE INJURED AND ONE WENT TO THE HOSPITAL. THE CALLER STATES THAT THE FIRE WAS EXTINGUISHED IMMEDIATELY.
